title: Engaging and interesting
text: This tour was absolutely amazing. Our tour guide,Adi, was engaging and knowledgeable. I would recommend this tour to anyone just wanting to learn a little more about Jewish life in Barcelona!
author: hungarian7

title: Excellent
text: We had a 2 hours Jewish tour in Barcelona.  Our guide - Adi Mahler- is very knowledgeable.  We had fun and learned a lot not only about Jewish people living in Barcelona many centuries ago but, also,  about Barcelona of that time.  It was very educational.  Thank you very much for having guides like Adl. Dina and Yefim Galitsky.
author: Dina_G

title: Excellent guide
text: Adi is very knowledgeable and fun.  We learned a lot and would definitely recommend to others who would like to learn not only about Jewish history, but the history of the Gothic Quarter.

title: Adi Mahler - the best tour guide in Barcelona !
text: Can’t thank Adi enough for our guided tour today.  So knowledgeable - not just about this subject - but the entire world.  Tied everything together beautifully and what a great sense of humor to go with his knowledge.  Thanks again 😊🙏
author: Rory_D

title: Excellent tour of Jewish Barcelona
text: Avi Mahler gave us a most interesting and insightful perspective on the Jews of Barcelona. I knew a lot about the presence of Jews here prior to to Inquisition but I learned so many new and interesting facts. There was a very strong Jewish presence here in Spain and I loved learning more about it. Thank you Avi Mahler.
author: Rosalyn_M

title: Great Journey into Jewish History
text: Great insight into the history of Jews in Barcelona.  Adi was a great tour guide and was very knowledgeable.
